info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Delivery API
Salesforce Experience Cloud Query Delivery Content by Channel

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Developer name of the content type (e.g., news, cms_image, cms_document, custom content types)

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for content variant (e.g., en_US, fr, de)

params.name: contentKeys
params.description: Comma-separated list of content keys to retrieve

params.name: managedContentIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of managed content record IDs

params.name: topics
params.description: Comma-separated list of topic names to filter content

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs for media references

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-indexed)

items.docs: Retrieves published CMS content from the specified delivery channel. Returns content items matching the specified content type and optional filters. Used for headless content delivery to external applications and decoupled frontends.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Search Delivery Content

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search term

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Filter results to a specific content type

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for content filtering

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-indexed)

items.docs: Searches published CMS content in the specified delivery channel using a full-text search term. Returns matching content items with relevance-based ordering.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Delivery Content Item

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: contentKeyOrId
params.description: Content key or managed content record ID

params.name: language
params.description: Language variant to retrieve

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs

items.docs: Retrieves a specific published content item from the delivery channel by its content key or managed content ID. Returns all content nodes and metadata for the item.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Content Binary Stream

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: contentKeyOrId
params.description: Content key or managed content record ID

items.docs: Returns the binary stream of published managed content such as images, documents, or videos. Used for downloading or streaming media files associated with CMS content.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud List Content Collections

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns a list of published content collections available in the specified delivery channel. Collections group related content items for organized delivery.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Content Collection

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS delivery channel

params.name: collectionKeyOrId
params.description: Collection key or record ID

params.name: language
params.description: Language variant to retrieve

params.name: showAbsoluteUrl
params.description: Whether to return absolute URLs

items.docs: Retrieves a specific content collection and its items from the delivery channel. Returns the collection metadata and all content items within the collection.
